title: Hyperlocal Weather, Air Quality, Pollen & Solar Dashboard
name: Hyperlocal Weather, Air Quality, Pollen & Solar Dashboard
user_prompt: Build a hyperlocal environmental intelligence and rooftop sustainability dashboard pre-seeded in Phoenix. Let users search any address or city via Places Autocomplete or click a building on the Google Map to inspect real-time environmental conditions at those coordinates: current weather and multi-day forecast metrics via the Weather API, local Air Quality Index (AQI), dominant pollutant, and health recommendations via the Air Quality API (plus optional AQI tile/layer toggle), tree/grass/weed pollen levels via the Pollen API, and rooftop solar panel capacity and annual sunshine hours via the Solar API building insights endpoint.
prompt: Build a hyperlocal environmental intelligence and rooftop sustainability dashboard pre-seeded in Phoenix. Let users search any address or city via Places Autocomplete or click a building on the Google Map to inspect real-time environmental conditions at those coordinates: current weather and multi-day forecast metrics via the Weather API, local Air Quality Index (AQI), dominant pollutant, and health recommendations via the Air Quality API (plus optional AQI tile/layer toggle), tree/grass/weed pollen levels via the Pollen API, and rooftop solar panel capacity and annual sunshine hours via the Solar API building insights endpoint.
expectations: Interactive map and Places Autocomplete location search are visible and pre-seeded
Live Weather API current conditions and forecast metrics are displayed
Live Air Quality API index/health guidance and Pollen API indicators are rendered
Solar API rooftop sunshine/panel potential metrics (or graceful non-coverage status) are displayed for the selected building
